policy: Pinned upstream template and tenant text retained with Apache license; only execution-environment wording and Pi output contract adapted. Local tenant replacement preserves mandatory trust/risk/outcome instructions.

contextSources.user: Pi input interactive/rpc; source-tagged custom entries persist original scope
contextSources.resumeAndFork: Public selected SessionManager.getBranch; custom provenance entries restore authorization; generated summaries and role=user without verified provenance remain evidence
contextSources.agents: before_agent_start.systemPromptOptions.contextFiles supplied by runtime, not a path read from tool output
contextSources.userConfirmation: Actual approval UI choice -> ReviewContextStore.confirm; explicit trusted adapters can record confirmations
contextSources.untrusted: Visible assistant text/tool calls/results; hidden thinking and binary content excluded
contextSources.compaction: Original source-tagged authorization preserved; omitted evidence labelled; cannot truncate required authority/action
contextSources.sessionTree: Resets context identity and cancellation at selected branch

modelResolution.default: Current Pi model through its public registry
modelResolution.override: reviewModel(provider,id) uses ModelRegistry.find; missing override fails closed
modelResolution.limits: Total caller/deadline signal, bounded rounds, model maxTokens cap, context capacity checks

investigationCapabilities.consumer: NativeExecutor with read-only profile, empty network allowlist and empty delta; protected controller paths denied
investigationCapabilities.evidence: Actual owned outside sentinel read on darwin-arm64; rejected write/network/escalation and cancelled requests; no external model calls

intermediateConsumer: ApprovalManager rejects nonempty auto-approved deltas until child 04 wires final native delivery; all new failure states deny and never fall back to UI
legacy: Explicit decision/reason providers remain supported conservatively; legacy allow cannot auto-increase permissions

finalFollowup.correction: Output guidance now preserves low-risk denials required by an explicit security policy, instead of suggesting every low-risk output must allow.
